cqc_correlation.note: rho_ij of the units of the combination (a repeated cluster is one unit), for the extracted modes; the periodic set uses its leading block

repeated_cluster_readings.reading_A: modes of one repeated cluster are summed algebraically first (the signed sums above), then the rule is applied across clusters; basis-invariant. Every *_combined block of this analysis is under reading A
repeated_cluster_readings.reading_B: the rule is applied over the individual vectors of whatever basis the solver returns; under SRSS the result depends on the basis. Published: its minimum and maximum per direction and quantity as the basis of each repeated pair rotates (each bound taken separately per quantity)
repeated_cluster_readings.note_CQC: CQC with rho = 1 within an exactly repeated cluster equals reading A under CQC for any basis

basis_1.construction: the canonical M-orthonormal basis of the pair, each vector then normalized to unit maximum translation (the published normalization)

basis_2.construction: the same M-orthonormal basis rotated by the angle with cos = 3/5, sin = 4/5 (an M-orthonormal rotation), each vector then normalized to unit maximum translation

euclidean_rotation_of_basis_2.construction: basis_2's normalized vectors rotated by cos = 3/5, sin = 4/5 in the Euclidean sense. In this pair the y- and z-plane modes are isotropic (equal generalized masses and equal Euclidean norms in every normalized M-orthogonal basis), so the rotated basis stays M-orthogonal and gives the same sums

sheared_basis_not_M_orthogonal.construction: counter-witness, outside the premise: basis_2's first vector and its second vector plus half the first, renormalized; it spans the eigenspace but is not M-orthogonal, and its sum differs

comparable at the verification tolerance: cluster_sum_signed of basis_1, basis_2 and euclidean_rotation_of_basis_2 (equal to each other and to the published cluster sum)
not comparable per mode: the basis of an: vectors[*]: generalized_mass_kg, participation_factor, tip_translation_uy_uz, contributions_signed, and M_cross_product_v1_M_v2_kg, in every basis
